Name: Better Farm Cave Forage - Add Ons
Author: StarandVeil
Description:
[size=4][font=Verdana][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55611/55611-1794799474-1715035785.png[/img][/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana]Inspired by the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10018]Better Farm Cave Forage[/url] (BFCF), you can now spawn various fruits, mushrooms, and or flowers from Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Cornucopia, and the vanilla game in your farm cave. [/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana]There are 3 spawn rate options with 3 seasonal options that you can choose from in many combinations. These mods were made to suit a variety of playstyles. You can download just 1 add on, 2, or all of them (though I recommend picking just one of the Cornucopia options).[/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana]You can change your settings whenever you want, but you must sleep at least once for the change to take effect. [/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana][u]With balance in mind, special mushrooms, fruit, and flowers that have additional requirements to unlock (like the Slime Berry and Monster Mushroom from SVE or the habanero from Cornucopia) were not included.[/u]

Want more [u]Better Farm Cave Forage[/u] mods? Check out the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10018]Better Farm Cave Forage[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/acearohippo?gameId=1303]acearohippo [/url](YES! 1.6 compatible) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/atelier99?gameId=1303]atelier99[/url]’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35194]Better Farm Cave Forage- WAG and RaTA[/url].[/font][/size]

[line]

[size=4][font=Verdana][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55611/55611-1794799458-1150691150.png[/img][/font][/size]

[font=Verdana][size=4]Below is general information. Rates may change depending on add on and seasonal settings. Check the Articles tab for more information.[/size][/font]

[size=4][font=Verdana][u][b]Seasonal Settings[/b][/u][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]Can select one or multiple options.[/font][/size]
[spoiler][size=4][font=Verdana]In Season-Allows in season fruit/mushrooms to spawn in the farm cave.
Out of Season-Allows out of season fruit/mushrooms to spawn in the farm cave.
Year Round-Allows fruit/mushrooms to spawn in the farm cave year-round.[/font][/size][/spoiler]
[size=4][font=Verdana]

[u][b]Spawn Settings [/b][/u][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Verdana]Keep in mind the size of your farm cave when selecting your preferred spawn rate. If you are using a smaller farm cave, I recommend having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]No Clip[/url] installed. (See video tab for the reason.)[/font][/size]

[size=4][font=Verdana]You can only select one spawn rate option. [/font][/size]

[spoiler][size=4][font=Verdana]Balanced- 0 to 2 spawns a day that despawn after 7 days. With the balanced option, forage will more than likely *not* to spawn. Great for those who play with Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul or a similar playstyle.
Unbalanced- 1-4 spawns a day that despawn after 4 days. Selecting multiple seasonal settings and/or having multiple BFCF mods installed will quickly fill up your farm cave. Spawns may go out of bounds when multiple seasonal settings are enabled and/or multiple BFCF packs installed. 
Unhinged-3-8 spawns a day that despawn after 2 days. This will fill up your farm cave quickly. Spawns are more likely to go out of bounds if using a small cave, especially with multiple BFCF mods installed.[/font][/size][/spoiler]
[size=4][font=Verdana]
You can install/uninstall the add ons at any time. If you uninstall without picking up any spawns in your farm cave, they will remain in the cave (unless you uninstalled the relevant expansion).

You may make personal edits to change settings to your liking.[/font][/size]
